purpose.title: Calendar of care
purpose.description: Important dates, people, and small steps Happy helps you remember at the right time.

form.title: Event title
form.importantHint: Happy will keep reminding you until it is done

empty.title: No events
empty.description: Add your first event to see it in the calendar.

validation.duration: Duration must be between 5 minutes and 24 hours.
validation.location: Location must be no longer than 300 characters.
validation.travelBuffer: Travel time must be between 5 and 240 minutes.

toast.addError: The event could not be added.
toast.reminderError: The event was saved, but its reminder could not be configured.
toast.deleteError: The event could not be deleted.
toast.fileError: The file could not be read.

dayPlan.title: Let’s plan this day
dayPlan.description: Choose the day boundaries. Happy creates a draft around durations, breaks and already busy time.
dayPlan.emptyTitle: Every task this day already has a time
dayPlan.emptyDescription: There are no tasks without a specific time. Happy will not change anything.
dayPlan.confirmationNote: This is only a draft. Order, times and durations are saved to the calendar only after your confirmation.
dayPlan.rangeError: The tasks do not fit in the selected day window. Change the start, end, duration or breaks.
dayPlan.validationError: At least one task must remain in the plan. Check the day boundaries, times and durations.
dayPlan.saveError: The whole plan could not be saved. Earlier changes were reverted where possible.
dayPlan.conflictError: Some tasks overlap each other or an existing event. Change the time or duration.
dayPlan.fixedProtected: Happy protected {count} existing events with confirmed durations.
dayPlan.missingFixedDuration: {count} events have a time but no duration. Add it so Happy can check overlaps accurately.
dayPlan.preferencesSaveError: Could not save defaults. The day plan was not changed.
dayPlan.preferencesLoadError: Could not load planning defaults. Safe initial values are being used.
dayPlan.reorderHint: Change the order with the arrows or adjust a duration — Happy immediately recalculates the following tasks around breaks and busy time.
dayPlan.excludedHint: These events stay in the calendar without a time. Happy does not delete or move them.
dayPlan.priorityHint: Happy places important tasks first in the draft.
dayPlan.deferred: {count, plural, one {# more task stays} other {# more tasks stay}} unchanged in the calendar. You can plan them separately after saving.
dayPlan.summary: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} · {minutes} min of focus · expected finish at {time}.
dayPlan.travelSummary: Happy also reserved {minutes} min for travel.
